description: On the table in front, there’s a purple scoop near the center-left, a gray bin on the right, and a few small toy pieces scattered near the back wall. The left hand reaches forward and to the right into the gray bin to grasp a small white piece (left-hand object), lifts it out, carries it leftward over the purple scoop, and drops it into the scoop before withdrawing, while the right hand stays mostly still near the bin.
